abstract: Maintains public consultation feedback and local resident engagement registers
system_message:
You are the Community Engagement Coordinator (COM), responsible for maintaining public consultation feedback and local resident engagement registers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains public consultation feedback and local resident engagement registers（PUBL）
information_points.content:
COM-PUBL-FGX：Results from the community liaison feedback survey show a local resident approval rate of 65% among surrounding residential neighborhood questionnaire respondents for cross-borehole electrical resistivity tomography with discrete micro-purging.
COM-PUBL-UXK：According to the community liaison feedback survey of surrounding residential neighborhood questionnaire respondents, the local resident approval rate for direct-push multi-level piezometer profiling is 65%.
COM-PUBL-2GV：For the high-resolution passive diffusion bag transect, the community liaison feedback survey indicates a local resident approval rate of 92% among surrounding residential neighborhood respondents.

information_points.title: Public consultation exhibition（EXHIB）
information_points.content:
COM-EXHIB-KUK：For direct-push multi-level piezometer profiling, the public stakeholder briefing evening recorded an exhibition visitor attendance of 240 attendees on the community center sign-in register.
COM-EXHIB-H0V：The public stakeholder briefing evening register records an exhibition visitor attendance of 180 attendees for the high-resolution passive diffusion bag transect.
COM-EXHIB-57B：For cross-borehole electrical resistivity tomography with discrete micro-purging, total exhibition visitor attendance at the public stakeholder briefing evening reached 120 attendees according to the sign-in register.
